verdict.rationale: Community reports show Vue organizes apps into modular single-file components with official router and store packages, which covers the 'modular building blocks' half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents a dependency-injection mechanism, and one user calls cross-component data passing awkward and says the global Vuex store breaks modularity. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation of dependency injection between components, evidence of injecting services or dependencies into components, and first-party docs on component modularity.
